name: 663. Replicate and Hugging Face image streams report the images delivered (image stream output count) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-8082 regression, contract C5. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream. The replicate and huggingface image streams used to end on a completed frame with no usage.output_images, and a stream was priced as one image whatever the vendor made. The fixture's replicate model fixture/image-stream-three streams one image and its finished prediction (urls.get) lists three, as a hosted model whose default is three images would. Its fal model fal-ai/fixture/image-stream-three streams a progress update ({progress, message}) and ends on the final result with three images. Pinned, on JSON /v1/images/generations and multipart /v1/images/edits, with n unset: the stream answers 200 with no error frame (a fal progress update used to end the stream as an error), ends on one completed frame, and that frame's usage.output_images is 3. On replicate, /__hits shows the finished prediction was read once.

item.name: replicate /v1/images/generations stream with n unset, whose finished prediction made three images, reports output_images 3 (image stream output count)

exec: if (pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixture') !== '1') {
pm.execution.skipRequest();
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl') + '/__reset', method: 'POST' }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('image stream output count setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null);
pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200);
var FX = pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl');
pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });
// The gateway's SSE frames, in order; [DONE] and comments are skipped.

var frames = pm.response.text().split(/\r?\n/).filter(function (l) { return l.indexOf('data:') === 0; }).map(function (l) { return l.slice(5).trim(); }).filter(function (d) { return d && d !== '[DONE]'; }).map(function (d) { try { return JSON.parse(d); } catch (e) { return { unparsed: d }; } });
pm.test('no frame is an error', function () { pm.expect(frames.filter(function (f) { return f.error; }), pm.response.text()).to.have.length(0); });
var completed = frames.filter(function (f) { return f.type === 'image_generation.completed' || f.type === 'image_edit.completed'; });
pm.test('the stream ends on one completed frame', function () { pm.expect(completed, pm.response.text()).to.have.length(1); });
var usage = completed.length ? completed[0].usage : undefined;
pm.test('the completed frame reports usage.output_images 3, the images the vendor made', function () { pm.expect(usage && usage.output_images, JSON.stringify(completed)).to.equal(3); });

pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__hits', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('the finished prediction was read once', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.json().data[0].hits['replicate.imgstream_three.poll'], JSON.stringify(res.json())).to.equal(1); }); });
